# 319_R6FIX.48 — R6 report-arm reconciliation contract (run ledger)

**Harness:** devin-cli / swe-2-high
**Base:** `main` `bf5650ea` · **Branch:** `stevenvitali/r6fix-48-report-reconciliation`
**Class:** run-time insert (harness only, $0)

## Finding → carrier

F-R6FIX.45-3, recorded 2026-11-25 during the funded R6 relaunch: run
`01M883HDHA717J6FS925PCHJYF` delivered verified (523cr committed meter / `cost.final`),
but the leg failed `report spent 360 < the card's committed meter 523 with no refund line
explaining the gap`. First read as a REQ-SPEC-32 report-disclosure defect; the live twin
read corrected it — the report renders the designed RPT.1 reconciliation
(`meteredCredits 523`, `spentCredits 360`, `differences [{absorbed:163},{cross_check:355}]`);
the leg's acceptance contract was too narrow (only `data-refund` counted as explanation).

## Change

`packages/journeys/src/steps.ts` — R6's report arm now sums the rendered credits of
gap-explaining `data-difference` rows (`cap`/`absorbed`/`entitlement`/`committed`/`refund`)
and requires them to equal `finalSpent − reportSpent` exactly; `cross_check` is
display-only. The `data-refund` special-case is subsumed (refund rows are difference rows).
`reportSpent > finalSpent` still fails hard.

re-authorized epoch): the leg's own 40-min poll bound expired mid-run while the run hiccuped

The delivered run `01M887YB5R4DNN4PNNE3VERCM5` is itself a true-up run: debits 627 +

Read-only verification of the repaired contract against the live report twin
(`/bff/p/jrn-13d002330575-r6excerpt/r/01M887YB…`): `spentCredits 627`,
